text:
Eli (Recruiter): Quick note  several interviewers reported their scorecards appeared blank after submitting during yesterday's panels. I pulled three candidate rows with empty feedback.

Maya (Recruiting Ops): Which candidates? Were there any UI changes rolled out?

Eli (Recruiter): CAND-9967, CAND-9970, CAND-9972. No org-wide notice about UI changes. Some interviewers said the finalize buttonlooked inactive.

Tasha (People Ops): Oof. We just added a small A/B test for a compact finalize button on a subset of users this morning. Could be related.

Noah (Eng Infra): scorecard-bot logs show 202 Accepted from client but stored_comments is null for those candidates. Snippet: 
``nPOST /api/scorecards 202
body: {"comments":"Looks strong", "finalize":true, "variant":"compact-finish"}
stored: {"comments":null}
```
Looks like mapper dropped 'comments' when variant present.

Maya (Recruiting Ops): Can we replay the requests? Recruiters need the qualitative feedback for debriefs.

Noah (Eng Infra): I'll run a log-scrape and add a compatibility rule to the mapper to accept variant-prefixed keys. ETA 3 hours. Will do dry-run first.

Tasha (People Ops): Temporary process: please DM interviewers to confirm they have copies of comments. Also postpone any hiring decisions until we reconcile for affected candidates.

Eli (Recruiter): I'll message the panels and ask them to paste comments to me if they still have them.

scorecard-bot: RECR-4212 created (assignee=noah, priority=high)

Noah (Eng Infra): Patch planned: accept both comments and variant_comments keys for 24h, log conversion. After replay I will attach recovered comments via admin API and post confirmation here.

Maya (Recruiting Ops): Also please add a small note to the interviewer checklist: "If finalize appears grey, wait for confirmation toast before closing tab." We'll include that in the recruiter follow-up.

Tasha (People Ops): Good. After recovery we'll schedule a 10-min training clip on finalize behavior and add a guardrail so variant deploys cannot change field IDs.

Eli (Recruiter): Thanks team. I'll update RECR-4212 with who responded and paste recovered comments when you attach them.
